observations.why: The 'we' pronoun enacts communal-sharing, pooling the team into an undifferentiated collective that shipped together.
Velocity measured in points is proportionality framing — output quantified and compared against a benchmark, the market-pricing relational form.
Casting an integration as the 'key unlock' frames it as the proportional lever that produced the outcome — cost-benefit attribution, the market-pricing form.
